references.text: Nethanel, son of Zuar, is first mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Issachar at the census.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Issachar at the dedication of the altar.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, led the army of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness journey.
The birth of Issachar as a son of Jacob and Leah, the patriarch of the tribe of Issachar.
Jacob's blessing over Issachar, describing the character of the tribe.
